name: Research use, human subjects and trial data
description: Research use, human subjects and trial data. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

frameworks.title: HIPAA 164.512(i), 45 CFR 46, 21 CFR 50, 56, Part 11, ICH E6(R3)

controls.title: Each research request carries a study ID that resolves to a registered study
controls.requirement: Each research request carries a study ID that resolves to a registered study.

controls.title: IRB approval is current at the time of the call
controls.requirement: IRB approval is current at the time of the call.

controls.title: Only fields in the approved protocol's data list are sent
controls.requirement: Only fields in the approved protocol's data list are sent.

controls.title: Informed consent in the current approved version is on file and not withdrawn
controls.requirement: Informed consent in the current approved version is on file and not withdrawn.

controls.title: Waived-consent studies carry the waiver determination
controls.requirement: Waived-consent studies carry the waiver determination.

controls.title: Broad consent for secondary research is respected
controls.requirement: Broad consent for secondary research is respected.

controls.title: Data from a withdrawn participant is excluded going forward
controls.requirement: Data from a withdrawn participant is excluded going forward.

controls.title: Vulnerable populations trigger the protections recorded in the approval
controls.requirement: Vulnerable populations trigger the protections recorded in the approval.

controls.title: Research disclosures under a waiver are logged for accounting
controls.requirement: Research disclosures under a waiver are logged for accounting.

controls.title: The model call is a listed processing step in the protocol or plan
controls.requirement: The model call is a listed processing step in the protocol or plan.

controls.title: Computerised systems for trial data meet Part 11: validation
controls.requirement: Computerised systems for trial data meet Part 11: validation, audit trails, access limits, linked signatures.

controls.title: Model-derived values are marked as such and never overwrite source data
controls.requirement: Model-derived values are marked as such and never overwrite source data.

controls.title: Sponsor
controls.requirement: Sponsor, investigator and vendor responsibilities for the agent are recorded.

controls.title: Unblinding is a human
controls.requirement: Unblinding is a human, role-restricted action; the agent can't reach treatment allocation.

controls.title: Adverse events the agent finds reach the safety role within the protocol's timeline
controls.requirement: Adverse events the agent finds reach the safety role within the protocol's timeline.

controls.title: Protocol deviations the agent causes are logged
controls.requirement: Protocol deviations the agent causes are logged.

controls.title: Eligibility output is signed off by the investigator before anyone is contacted
controls.requirement: Eligibility output is signed off by the investigator before anyone is contacted.

controls.title: Recruitment messages use IRB-approved text only
controls.requirement: Recruitment messages use IRB-approved text only.

controls.title: Data sharing and publication follow the study's plan and any certificate of confidentialit
controls.requirement: Data sharing and publication follow the study's plan and any certificate of confidentiality.

controls.title: Registration and results-reporting dates are attested
controls.requirement: Registration and results-reporting dates are attested.

controls.title: Study records are kept for the longest applicable period
controls.requirement: Study records are kept for the longest applicable period.
